description: This file contains functions for managing browser cookies, including getting, setting, deleting cookies, and handling sub-cookie structures.

methods.name: Get_Cookie(name)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie by name.

methods.name: Set_Cookie( name, value, expires, path, domain, secure )
methods.description: Sets a cookie with specified attributes such as name, value, expiration, path, domain, and security.

methods.name: Delete_Cookie(name,path,domain)
methods.description: Deletes a specified cookie by name, path, and domain.

methods.name: get_sub_cookies(cookie)
methods.description: Parses a cookie string and returns an array of sub-cookie key-value pairs.

methods.name: subs_to_cookie(cookies)
methods.description: Converts a set of sub-cookies into a single string suitable for storing as a cookie.

ctags.name: Set_Cookie
ctags.pattern: /^function Set_Cookie( name, value, expires, path, domain, secure ) $/
ctags.signature: ( name, value, expires, path, domain, secure )
